chapter_title: Multimedia Storyboarding and AI Asset Generation
title: Storyboard Frames as Claims
description: Artifact-specific exemplar for AIL 606 connecting storyboard frames as claims to cognitive load diagnostic table, social annotation signals, and adaptive learner-model evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze a cognitive load diagnostic table as evidence of learner judgment in AIL 606.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Identify annotation, artifact, support, and calibration signals for intelligent textbook research.
